patterns.name: SQL injection syntax
patterns.rationale: The request argument matches SQL syntax patterns used to identify SQL injection attempts; descriptive fields and count markers are not used.
patterns.condition: SQL query syntax in a configured request argument: UNION SELECT, SELECT ... FROM, a boolean equality clause, a SQL comment marker, or an OR/AND quote form.

patterns.name: Script tag injection
patterns.rationale: The request argument contains a script tag, a direct signal of script injection.
patterns.condition: A complete opening or closing script tag appears in a configured request argument.

patterns.name: Repeated path traversal
patterns.rationale: Repeated parent-directory traversal segments are the configured clear path traversal signal.
patterns.condition: Two or more ../ or ..\ segments appear consecutively in a configured request argument.

ambiguousPatterns.name: Partial SQL syntax
ambiguousPatterns.condition: A configured SQL keyword sequence is incomplete at the end of the request argument.
ambiguousPatterns.rationale: A partial SQL construct is an uncertain SQL-injection signal; it is retained as alert-only evidence.

ambiguousPatterns.name: Incomplete script tag
ambiguousPatterns.condition: A script tag opener is present without a completed tag.
ambiguousPatterns.rationale: An incomplete script tag is an uncertain script-injection signal; it is retained as alert-only evidence.

ambiguousPatterns.name: Single traversal segment
ambiguousPatterns.condition: One ../ or ..\ segment appears, without the repeated traversal required by the clear pattern.
ambiguousPatterns.rationale: A single traversal segment can occur in ordinary paths; repeated traversal is required for the clear pattern.

ambiguousPatterns.name: Isolated quote
ambiguousPatterns.condition: A quote appears at a request-argument boundary without a configured SQL construct.
ambiguousPatterns.rationale: An isolated quote alone is weak context and is alert-only rather than a clear SQL-injection match.

ambiguousPatterns.name: Command separator with command token
ambiguousPatterns.condition: A separator is followed by one of the configured command tokens.
ambiguousPatterns.rationale: This retained ambiguous signal is alert-only and is not sufficient for blocking.

decisionPolicy.block: 요청의 명확한 패턴 정확히 하나, 유효한 출처, 같은 출처·패턴의 서로 다른 경보 ID가 둘 이상이라는 실행기 계산 상관 근거가 모두 필요합니다.
decisionPolicy.alert: 명확한 단일 패턴이나 요청 데이터의 모호한 주입·명령 구분자 신호가 확인되거나, 패턴이 겹치는 경우입니다. 모호 패턴은 반복 차단 증거로 사용하지 않습니다.
decisionPolicy.record: 요청에 공격 또는 모호 신호가 없습니다. 설명, 심각도, MITRE 메타데이터, marker, count는 공격 증거가 아닙니다.
